personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT (Duolingo-style gamified learning path for Mexican youth & students)
personality_one_liner: An interactive, joyful cybersecurity learning adventure designed for Mexican students to conquer online scams and cyber threats through playful daily paths and instant rewards.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous, friendly tactile padding with chunky rounded containers and clear touch targets (≥44pt).

do's: Use chunky rounded cards with soft spring press feedback
Keep touch targets large and friendly
Use high contrast text on pastel/saturated surfaces
dont's: Avoid sharp brutalist edges or dark corporate SaaS layouts

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Engaging onboarding introduction to Hack-Seguro with Mexican youth context and swift sign-in.

states.loading: Centered friendly bouncing loader with brand colors

screens.layout: Full-bleed playful hero background, vibrant mascot introduction, clear value proposition about defeating cyber threats in Mexico, and chunky pill primary CTA.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Main hub displaying streak, XP, CiberMonedas, daily status, and the Duolingo-style learning path.

states.loading: Skeleton path nodes with pulsing pulse animation
states.empty: Prompt to start your first cybersecurity module

screens.layout: Sticky top status bar (streak count, hearts, XP, CiberMonedas), scrolling linear interactive path with node checkpoints ('Fraude WhatsApp', 'Becas Falsas', 'Paquetería Falsa'), and sticky bottom tab navigation.

screens.name: LearningPath
screens.purpose: Interactive Duolingo-style linear curriculum organized into units and lessons.

states.empty: No active modules found. Tap to refresh.
states.error: Failed to load lessons. Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical winding path with playful node icons, unit header banners ('Módulo 1: Alerta de Fraudes'), locked/unlocked state badges, and quick start action.

screens.name: InteractiveLesson
screens.purpose: Engaging lesson screen supporting quizzes, true/false, and spot-the-fake-message challenges.

states.empty: No questions available in this lesson.

screens.layout: Top progress bar with close button and heart count, center interactive card displaying a simulated Mexican scam text message (e.g. fake delivery SMS from Estafeta/DHL), multiple-choice option buttons, and sticky bottom check/continue button.

screens.name: CiberBot
screens.purpose: Educational chatbot answering common Mexican cybersecurity questions (WhatsApp scams, scholarships, parcels).

states.empty: Ask CiberBot anything about online safety in Mexico!

screens.layout: Chat message history with rounded message bubbles, quick preset question chips ('¿Es real este mensaje de WhatsApp?', '¿Cómo identifico una beca falsa?'), and sticky input bar with send button.

screens.name: MiniGames
screens.purpose: Interactive arcade mini-games ('Fraude o Real', 'Memorama Ciber', 'Reto de Contraseña') to test skills.
screens.layout: Grid of game cards with vibrant illustrations, difficulty badges, reward counters (XP + CiberMonedas), and launch CTA.

screens.name: GamificationHub
screens.purpose: Rewards center displaying achievements, badge collection, chest openings, and daily streak rewards.

states.empty: Complete your first lesson to earn badges!

screens.layout: Top summary of CiberMonedas and streak count, grid of unlocked/locked shields and cyber badges, daily reward chest claim card, and leaderboard snippet.

screens.name: FamilySchool
screens.purpose: Dedicated portal for parents and teachers to track student certificates and progress.

states.error: Failed to load report data. Retry.

screens.layout: Summary report card, downloadable safety certificate preview, tips for parents in Mexico, and export progress button.

screens.name: ProfileSettings
screens.purpose: User profile, streak status, accessibility settings (large text, high contrast, sound), and account customization.
screens.layout: User avatar header with XP badge, settings list grouped with tinted icon containers, accessibility toggles for high contrast and large text, and sign out.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Duolingo-style linear learning path on the Dashboard and LearningPath screens with clear node checkpoints.
Ensure all buttons use chunky rounded pill styling with spring press feedback and touch targets >= 44x44pt.
Mexican cybersecurity context is core: simulate common local scams (WhatsApp delivery notices, fake Bienestar scholarships, false bank alerts).
Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality: warm cream surface, vibrant orange brand primary, deep ink text, no purple/indigo/navy tones.
Every screen must feature Loading, Empty, and Error full-screen states.
Icons must use Phosphor icon set consistently across all tabs and actions.
